question: Should OpenClaw officially bundle and support this Twilio-backed RCS channel, or should it ship as an external ClawHub plugin with only narrowly necessary generic core seams merged here?
rationale: Both shapes are technically possible, but bundling establishes long-term channel, provider, configuration, security, and upgrade commitments that repository policy and the linked feature discussion leave to maintainers.

options.title: Externalize through ClawHub
options.body: Publish RCS as an external channel plugin and split any missing generic HTTP-registration capability into a focused core change.

options.title: Sponsor bundled RCS
options.body: Accept RCS as an official bundled channel after the storage, dependency, upgrade, and live-proof gates are satisfied.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Keep the feature issue open while declining this branch until provider demand and ownership justify either distribution model.

recommendation.title: Externalize through ClawHub
recommendation.body: Publish RCS as an external channel plugin and split any missing generic HTTP-registration capability into a focused core change.

likelyOwner.reason: The bundled Twilio SMS channel was introduced under this ownership trail, making this the strongest available precedent for deciding whether its RCS sibling belongs at the same distribution tier.
